about: Markdown frontmatter inside lampstand's YAML subset. Parsing `input` yields `expected`: frontmatter (a mapping, or null when the file has none), body (the text after the closing fence, LF-normalized, BOM removed) and bodyLine (the 1-based file line where the body starts).

vectors.description: no frontmatter
a fence that is not on the first line is not frontmatter
a thematic break with text after the dashes is not a fence
empty file
empty frontmatter
frontmatter of comments and blank lines only
a file that ends at the closing fence without a newline
fences may carry trailing whitespace
an Agent Skills SKILL.md

name: pdf-tools
description: Extract text and tables from PDF files. Use when the user mentions PDFs.

allowed-tools: [Read, Bash]
metadata:

  version: "1.0"
---
